## Props

| Prop          | Type                          | Default        | Description                    |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'`  | `'horizontal'` | Separator direction            |
| `className`   | `string`                      | —              | Additional CSS classes         |
| `style`       | `CSSProperties`               | —              | Inline styles                  |
| `...props`    | `ComponentProps<typeof Base>` | —              | Base UI separator props/events |

# Sheet

> A side-anchored dialog that slides in from any edge — for navigation, filters, forms, and inspectors.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/sheet

## Preview

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetBody,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/Sheet';

export function SheetExample() {
  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger render={<Button>Open Sheet</Button>} />
      <SheetContent>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Edit profile</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you are
            done.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetBody>
          <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
            <p>
              Sheet body content — drop forms, lists, or any custom
              layout here.
            </p>
            <p>
              It scrolls independently from the header and footer.
            </p>
          </div>
        </SheetBody>
        <SheetFooter>
          <SheetClose
            render={
              <Button variant="text" theme="default">
                Cancel
              </Button>
            }
          />
          <SheetClose render={<Button>Save</Button>} />
        </SheetFooter>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

## Usage

`Sheet` is built on Base UI Dialog. The `SheetContent` part bundles the portal, overlay, popup, and a corner close button so the common case is a single composition.

## Sides

The `side` prop on `SheetContent` controls which edge the sheet slides in from.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetBody,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/Sheet';

const sides = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'] as const;

export function SheetSidesExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
      {sides.map((side) => (
        <Sheet key={side}>
          <SheetTrigger
            render={<Button className="capitalize">{side}</Button>}
          />
          <SheetContent side={side}>
            <SheetHeader>
              <SheetTitle className="capitalize">
                {side} sheet
              </SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>
                Sheet position is controlled by the side prop.
              </SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <SheetBody>
              The sheet slides in from the {side} edge.
            </SheetBody>
            <SheetFooter>
              <SheetClose
                render={
                  <Button variant="text" theme="default">
                    Close
                  </Button>
                }
              />
            </SheetFooter>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Non-modal docked panel

Pass `modal={false}` on the `Sheet` root to drop the backdrop and keep the page interactive. Use this for filters, inspectors, or any panel that should coexist with the main content.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetBody,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/Sheet';

export function SheetNonModalDockedPanelExample() {
  return (
    <Sheet modal={false}>
      <SheetTrigger render={<Button>Open docked panel</Button>} />
      <SheetContent>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Docked panel</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            The page stays interactive and is not dimmed while this
            sheet is open.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetBody>
          Use a non-modal Sheet for filters, inspectors, or side
          panels that should coexist with the main content.
        </SheetBody>
        <SheetFooter>
          <SheetClose
            render={
              <Button variant="text" theme="default">
                Close
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </SheetFooter>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

The overlay rendering is tied to `modal` automatically — when the sheet is non-modal, no backdrop is rendered.

## Hidden Close Button

Pass `showCloseButton={false}` on `SheetContent` to drop the corner close button when the flow needs an explicit footer action to finish.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetBody,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/Sheet';

export function SheetHiddenCloseButtonExample() {
  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger
        render={<Button>Open without close button</Button>}
      />
      <SheetContent showCloseButton={false}>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>No corner close</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Use the footer action to dismiss this sheet.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetBody>
          Useful for flows that require explicit confirmation.
        </SheetBody>
        <SheetFooter>
          <SheetClose render={<Button>Done</Button>} />
        </SheetFooter>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger />
  <SheetContent>
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle />
      <SheetDescription />
    </SheetHeader>
    <SheetBody />
    <SheetFooter>
      <SheetClose />
    </SheetFooter>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```

## Props

`Sheet` accepts Base UI `Dialog.Root` props, including `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, and `modal`.

### SheetContent

| Prop               | Type                                     | Default   | Description                                    |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `side`             | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'right'` | Edge the sheet slides in from                  |
| `showCloseButton`  | `boolean`                                | `true`    | Render a corner close button                   |
| `closeLabel`       | `string`                                 | `'Close'` | `aria-label` for the corner close button       |
| `overlayClassName` | `string`                                 | -         | Custom classes for the overlay (when rendered) |
| `portalContainer`  | `HTMLElement \| null`                    | -         | Custom portal container                        |
| `className`        | `string`                                 | -         | Additional classes on the popup                |

## Accessibility

Always include `SheetTitle` for screen readers; add `SheetDescription` when the sheet's purpose is not obvious from the title alone. Keep destructive or irreversible actions explicit in the footer.

# Sidebar

> Application sidebar with structure, behavior, and a basic neutral default skin. Product-specific looks live on blocks.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/sidebar

## Preview

> **Boundary**
>
> - **Primitive:** structure + behavior (collapse, cookie, ⌘B, mobile sheet) and shadcn-aligned `data-slot` / `data-side` / `data-variant` / `data-state` on every panel branch, **plus a basic default skin** (grayscale text and hover/active fill — not shadcn `sidebar-accent`). No product-only decorations such as the rail left bar.
> - **Product styles / full shells:** [Cloud](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/flat) — [Flat](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/flat), [Inline Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/inline-submenus), [Collapsible Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/collapsible-submenus), [Dropdown Submenus](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/dropdown-submenus), [Secondary Nav](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/secondary-nav), [Header Actions](/docs/blocks/sidebar/cloud/header-actions).
> - **Colors:** semantic slots `--sidebar*` (from `tokens/semantic/color.json` → `generated.css`) color the chrome. Menu item default skin stays `grayscale-*`. See [Colors → Sidebar](/docs/design-tokens/colors#sidebar).
> - **`SidebarProvider`** wraps children in `TooltipProvider delay={0}` (same as shadcn), so tooltips under `SidebarInset` also open immediately.
>
> Header / Footer “sticky” is **flex pin**: siblings of `SidebarContent`, not inside it. Only `SidebarContent` scrolls.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';
import { CalendarDaysIcon } from '@/components/icons/CalendarDaysIcon';
import { CheckIcon } from '@/components/icons/CheckIcon';
import { ClockIcon } from '@/components/icons/ClockIcon';
import { EllipsisIcon } from '@/components/icons/EllipsisIcon';
import { FlagIcon } from '@/components/icons/FlagIcon';
import { MagnifyingGlassIcon } from '@/components/icons/MagnifyingGlassIcon';
import { PanelLeftIcon } from '@/components/icons/PanelLeftIcon';
import { UserIcon } from '@/components/icons/UserIcon';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';

// Keeps the fixed sidebar inside this demo box. In an app, drop the frame:
// the sidebar is fixed to the viewport.
const DEMO_FRAME =
  'relative h-[640px] w-full overflow-hidden ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!absolute ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!inset-y-0 ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!h-full ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!max-h-full';

type NavItem = {
  label: string;
  icon: ReactNode;
  isActive?: boolean;
  items?: { label: string; isActive?: boolean }[];
};

const nav: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Overview',
    items: [
      { label: 'Dashboard', icon: <PanelLeftIcon />, isActive: true },
      { label: 'Inbox', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
      { label: 'Calendar', icon: <CalendarDaysIcon /> },
      { label: 'Approvals', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      {
        label: 'Projects',
        icon: <FlagIcon />,
        items: [
          { label: 'In progress' },
          { label: 'Completed' },
          { label: 'Archived' },
        ],
      },
      { label: 'Clients', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Invoices', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Reports', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
      { label: 'Documents', icon: <FlagIcon /> },
      { label: 'Analytics', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Organization',
    items: [
      { label: 'Members', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Roles & access', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
      { label: 'Billing', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Integrations', icon: <PanelLeftIcon /> },
      { label: 'Audit log', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
    ],
  },
];

function BrandHeader() {
  const { state, isMobile } = useSidebar();
  const collapsed = !isMobile && state === 'collapsed';

  return (
    <SidebarHeader className="py-2">
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={
                <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Workspace" />
              }
            >
              {collapsed ? (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="size-8 object-contain"
                />
              ) : (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo-text-h.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="h-7 max-h-7 w-auto object-contain object-left"
                />
              )}
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="start"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Workspaces</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Design</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Finance</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Create workspace</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>Workspace settings</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarHeader>
  );
}

function NavMain() {
  return (
    <SidebarContent>
      {nav.map((group) => (
        <SidebarGroup key={group.label}>
          <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>
          <SidebarGroupContent>
            <SidebarMenu>
              {group.items.map((item) => (
                <SidebarMenuItem key={item.label}>
                  <SidebarMenuButton
                    isActive={item.isActive && !item.items}
                    tooltip={item.label}
                  >
                    {item.icon}
                    <span>{item.label}</span>
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                  {item.items ? (
                    <SidebarMenuSub>
                      {item.items.map((sub) => (
                        <SidebarMenuSubItem key={sub.label}>
                          <SidebarMenuSubButton
                            isActive={sub.isActive}
                          >
                            <span>{sub.label}</span>
                          </SidebarMenuSubButton>
                        </SidebarMenuSubItem>
                      ))}
                    </SidebarMenuSub>
                  ) : null}
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              ))}
            </SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroupContent>
        </SidebarGroup>
      ))}
    </SidebarContent>
  );
}

function UserFooter() {
  return (
    <SidebarFooter>
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={<SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Ray" />}
            >
              <Avatar
                name="Ray"
                src="/images/ray.jpg"
                size="sm"
                className="size-8 shrink-0"
              />
              <span>Ray</span>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="end"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Ray</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Account settings</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Preferences</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Sign out</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarFooter>
  );
}

export function SidebarExample() {
  return (
    <div className={DEMO_FRAME}>
      <SidebarProvider
        defaultOpen
        enableKeyboardShortcut={false}
        className="h-full min-h-0"
      >
        <Sidebar side="left" variant="sidebar" collapsible="icon">
          <BrandHeader />
          <NavMain />
          <UserFooter />
          <SidebarRail />
        </Sidebar>
        <SidebarInset>
          <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 border-b border-sidebar-border px-4">
            <SidebarTrigger />
            <span className="text-sm text-sidebar-foreground">
              Dashboard
            </span>
          </header>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col" />
        </SidebarInset>
      </SidebarProvider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @vital-design/sidebar
```

## Usage

Wrap your layout with `SidebarProvider`, compose the shell with `Sidebar` + `SidebarInset`, and build navigation with the menu parts. Basic styles come free; use a **block** or `className` for product-specific skins.

```tsx
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';

export function AppLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <Sidebar collapsible="icon">
        <SidebarHeader>Brand</SidebarHeader>
        <SidebarContent>
          <SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroupLabel>Platform</SidebarGroupLabel>
            <SidebarGroupContent>
              <SidebarMenu>
                <SidebarMenuItem>
                  <SidebarMenuButton isActive tooltip="Home">
                    Home
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              </SidebarMenu>
            </SidebarGroupContent>
          </SidebarGroup>
        </SidebarContent>
      </Sidebar>
      <SidebarInset>
        <header>
          <SidebarTrigger />
        </header>
        {children}
      </SidebarInset>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
```

## Structure

| Part                                                 | Role                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `SidebarProvider`                                    | Collapsible state, cookie (`cookieName`), keyboard shortcut (`enableKeyboardShortcut`), mobile check (`isMobile`) |
| `Sidebar`                                            | Main panel (`side`, `variant`, `collapsible`, `render`)                                                           |
| `SidebarTrigger` / `SidebarRail`                     | Toggle controls                                                                                                   |
| `SidebarInset`                                       | Primary content region                                                                                            |
| `SidebarHeader` / `SidebarFooter` / `SidebarContent` | Sticky header/footer and scrollable body                                                                          |
| `SidebarGroup*`                                      | Labeled sections inside content                                                                                   |
| `SidebarMenu*`                                       | Navigation rows, actions, badges, skeletons, nested submenus                                                      |

## Collapsible modes

- `offcanvas` (default) — hides off-screen when collapsed
- `icon` — collapses to an icon rail; menu labels hide; `tooltip` shows on hover
- `none` — fixed width, not collapsible

With `offcanvas`, the trigger slides the whole panel out of view:

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';
import { CalendarDaysIcon } from '@/components/icons/CalendarDaysIcon';
import { CheckIcon } from '@/components/icons/CheckIcon';
import { ClockIcon } from '@/components/icons/ClockIcon';
import { EllipsisIcon } from '@/components/icons/EllipsisIcon';
import { FlagIcon } from '@/components/icons/FlagIcon';
import { MagnifyingGlassIcon } from '@/components/icons/MagnifyingGlassIcon';
import { PanelLeftIcon } from '@/components/icons/PanelLeftIcon';
import { UserIcon } from '@/components/icons/UserIcon';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';

// Keeps the fixed sidebar inside this demo box. In an app, drop the frame:
// the sidebar is fixed to the viewport.
const DEMO_FRAME =
  'relative h-[640px] w-full overflow-hidden ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!absolute ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!inset-y-0 ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!h-full ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!max-h-full';

type NavItem = {
  label: string;
  icon: ReactNode;
  isActive?: boolean;
  items?: { label: string; isActive?: boolean }[];
};

const nav: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Overview',
    items: [
      { label: 'Dashboard', icon: <PanelLeftIcon />, isActive: true },
      { label: 'Inbox', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
      { label: 'Calendar', icon: <CalendarDaysIcon /> },
      { label: 'Approvals', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      {
        label: 'Projects',
        icon: <FlagIcon />,
        items: [
          { label: 'In progress' },
          { label: 'Completed' },
          { label: 'Archived' },
        ],
      },
      { label: 'Clients', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Invoices', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Reports', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
      { label: 'Documents', icon: <FlagIcon /> },
      { label: 'Analytics', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Organization',
    items: [
      { label: 'Members', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Roles & access', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
      { label: 'Billing', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Integrations', icon: <PanelLeftIcon /> },
      { label: 'Audit log', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
    ],
  },
];

function BrandHeader() {
  const { state, isMobile } = useSidebar();
  const collapsed = !isMobile && state === 'collapsed';

  return (
    <SidebarHeader className="py-2">
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={
                <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Workspace" />
              }
            >
              {collapsed ? (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="size-8 object-contain"
                />
              ) : (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo-text-h.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="h-7 max-h-7 w-auto object-contain object-left"
                />
              )}
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="start"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Workspaces</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Design</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Finance</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Create workspace</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>Workspace settings</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarHeader>
  );
}

function NavMain() {
  return (
    <SidebarContent>
      {nav.map((group) => (
        <SidebarGroup key={group.label}>
          <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>
          <SidebarGroupContent>
            <SidebarMenu>
              {group.items.map((item) => (
                <SidebarMenuItem key={item.label}>
                  <SidebarMenuButton
                    isActive={item.isActive && !item.items}
                    tooltip={item.label}
                  >
                    {item.icon}
                    <span>{item.label}</span>
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                  {item.items ? (
                    <SidebarMenuSub>
                      {item.items.map((sub) => (
                        <SidebarMenuSubItem key={sub.label}>
                          <SidebarMenuSubButton
                            isActive={sub.isActive}
                          >
                            <span>{sub.label}</span>
                          </SidebarMenuSubButton>
                        </SidebarMenuSubItem>
                      ))}
                    </SidebarMenuSub>
                  ) : null}
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              ))}
            </SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroupContent>
        </SidebarGroup>
      ))}
    </SidebarContent>
  );
}

function UserFooter() {
  return (
    <SidebarFooter>
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={<SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Ray" />}
            >
              <Avatar
                name="Ray"
                src="/images/ray.jpg"
                size="sm"
                className="size-8 shrink-0"
              />
              <span>Ray</span>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="end"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Ray</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Account settings</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Preferences</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Sign out</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarFooter>
  );
}

export function SidebarCollapsibleOffcanvasExample() {
  return (
    <div className={DEMO_FRAME}>
      <SidebarProvider
        defaultOpen
        enableKeyboardShortcut={false}
        className="h-full min-h-0"
      >
        <Sidebar
          side="left"
          variant="sidebar"
          collapsible="offcanvas"
        >
          <BrandHeader />
          <NavMain />
          <UserFooter />
          <SidebarRail />
        </Sidebar>
        <SidebarInset>
          <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 border-b border-sidebar-border px-4">
            <SidebarTrigger />
            <span className="text-sm text-sidebar-foreground">
              Dashboard
            </span>
          </header>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col" />
        </SidebarInset>
      </SidebarProvider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Variants

### Inset

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';

  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';
```

### Floating

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';
import { CalendarDaysIcon } from '@/components/icons/CalendarDaysIcon';
import { CheckIcon } from '@/components/icons/CheckIcon';
import { ClockIcon } from '@/components/icons/ClockIcon';
import { EllipsisIcon } from '@/components/icons/EllipsisIcon';
import { FlagIcon } from '@/components/icons/FlagIcon';
import { MagnifyingGlassIcon } from '@/components/icons/MagnifyingGlassIcon';
import { PanelLeftIcon } from '@/components/icons/PanelLeftIcon';
import { UserIcon } from '@/components/icons/UserIcon';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';

// Keeps the fixed sidebar inside this demo box. In an app, drop the frame:
// the sidebar is fixed to the viewport.
const DEMO_FRAME =
  'relative h-[640px] w-full overflow-hidden ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!absolute ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!inset-y-0 ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!h-full ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!max-h-full';

type NavItem = {
  label: string;
  icon: ReactNode;
  isActive?: boolean;
  items?: { label: string; isActive?: boolean }[];
};

const nav: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Overview',
    items: [

      { label: 'Inbox', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },

          { label: 'In progress' },
          { label: 'Completed' },
          { label: 'Archived' },

  },

    label: 'Organization',
    items: [
      { label: 'Members', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Roles & access', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
      { label: 'Billing', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Integrations', icon: <PanelLeftIcon /> },
      { label: 'Audit log', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
    ],
  },
];

  const { state, isMobile } = useSidebar();
  const collapsed = !isMobile && state === 'collapsed';

  return (
    <SidebarHeader className="py-2">
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>

              render={

                  src="/images/vital-logo.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="size-8 object-contain"
                />
              ) : (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo-text-h.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="h-7 max-h-7 w-auto object-contain object-left"
                />
              )}
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"

              sideOffset={16}

        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>

  );

function NavMain() {
  return (
    <SidebarContent>
      {nav.map((group) => (
        <SidebarGroup key={group.label}>
          <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>

              render={<SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Ray" />}

              <Avatar
                name="Ray"
                src="/images/ray.jpg"
                size="sm"
                className="size-8 shrink-0"
              />
              <span>Ray</span>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="end"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Ray</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Account settings</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Preferences</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Sign out</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarFooter>
  );
}

export function SidebarFloatingExample() {
  return (
    <div className={DEMO_FRAME}>
      <SidebarProvider
        defaultOpen
        enableKeyboardShortcut={false}
        className="h-full min-h-0"
      >
        <Sidebar side="left" variant="floating" collapsible="icon">
          <BrandHeader />
          <NavMain />
          <UserFooter />
          <SidebarRail />
        </Sidebar>
        <SidebarInset>
          <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 px-4">
            <SidebarTrigger />
          </header>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col" />
        </SidebarInset>
      </SidebarProvider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Right side

Set `side="right"` to dock the sidebar on the right. Put the `SidebarTrigger` at the end of the header so it sits next to the panel.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from '@/components/ui/Sidebar';
import { CalendarDaysIcon } from '@/components/icons/CalendarDaysIcon';
import { CheckIcon } from '@/components/icons/CheckIcon';
import { ClockIcon } from '@/components/icons/ClockIcon';
import { EllipsisIcon } from '@/components/icons/EllipsisIcon';
import { FlagIcon } from '@/components/icons/FlagIcon';
import { MagnifyingGlassIcon } from '@/components/icons/MagnifyingGlassIcon';
import { PanelLeftIcon } from '@/components/icons/PanelLeftIcon';
import { UserIcon } from '@/components/icons/UserIcon';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';

// Keeps the fixed sidebar inside this demo box. In an app, drop the frame:
// the sidebar is fixed to the viewport.
const DEMO_FRAME =
  'relative h-[640px] w-full overflow-hidden ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!absolute ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!inset-y-0 ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!h-full ' +
  '[&_[data-slot=sidebar-container]]:!max-h-full';

type NavItem = {
  label: string;
  icon: ReactNode;
  isActive?: boolean;
  items?: { label: string; isActive?: boolean }[];
};

const nav: { label: string; items: NavItem[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Overview',
    items: [
      { label: 'Dashboard', icon: <PanelLeftIcon />, isActive: true },
      { label: 'Inbox', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
      { label: 'Calendar', icon: <CalendarDaysIcon /> },
      { label: 'Approvals', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [
      {
        label: 'Projects',
        icon: <FlagIcon />,
        items: [
          { label: 'In progress' },
          { label: 'Completed' },
          { label: 'Archived' },
        ],
      },
      { label: 'Clients', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Invoices', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Reports', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
      { label: 'Documents', icon: <FlagIcon /> },
      { label: 'Analytics', icon: <MagnifyingGlassIcon /> },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Organization',
    items: [
      { label: 'Members', icon: <UserIcon /> },
      { label: 'Roles & access', icon: <CheckIcon /> },
      { label: 'Billing', icon: <ClockIcon /> },
      { label: 'Integrations', icon: <PanelLeftIcon /> },
      { label: 'Audit log', icon: <EllipsisIcon /> },
    ],
  },
];

function BrandHeader() {
  const { state, isMobile } = useSidebar();
  const collapsed = !isMobile && state === 'collapsed';

  return (
    <SidebarHeader className="py-2">
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={
                <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Workspace" />
              }
            >
              {collapsed ? (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="size-8 object-contain"
                />
              ) : (
                <img
                  src="/images/vital-logo-text-h.svg"
                  alt="Vittal"
                  className="h-7 max-h-7 w-auto object-contain object-left"
                />
              )}
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="start"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Workspaces</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Design</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Vittal Finance</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Create workspace</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>Workspace settings</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarHeader>
  );
}

function NavMain() {
  return (
    <SidebarContent>
      {nav.map((group) => (
        <SidebarGroup key={group.label}>
          <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>
          <SidebarGroupContent>
            <SidebarMenu>
              {group.items.map((item) => (
                <SidebarMenuItem key={item.label}>
                  <SidebarMenuButton
                    isActive={item.isActive && !item.items}
                    tooltip={item.label}
                  >
                    {item.icon}
                    <span>{item.label}</span>
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                  {item.items ? (
                    <SidebarMenuSub>
                      {item.items.map((sub) => (
                        <SidebarMenuSubItem key={sub.label}>
                          <SidebarMenuSubButton
                            isActive={sub.isActive}
                          >
                            <span>{sub.label}</span>
                          </SidebarMenuSubButton>
                        </SidebarMenuSubItem>
                      ))}
                    </SidebarMenuSub>
                  ) : null}
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              ))}
            </SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroupContent>
        </SidebarGroup>
      ))}
    </SidebarContent>
  );
}

function UserFooter() {
  return (
    <SidebarFooter>
      <SidebarMenu>
        <SidebarMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger
              render={<SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Ray" />}
            >
              <Avatar
                name="Ray"
                src="/images/ray.jpg"
                size="sm"
                className="size-8 shrink-0"
              />
              <span>Ray</span>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent
              side="right"
              align="end"
              sideOffset={16}
            >
              <DropdownMenuGroup>
                <DropdownMenuLabel>Ray</DropdownMenuLabel>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Account settings</DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem>Preferences</DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              <DropdownMenuItem>Sign out</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarMenuItem>
      </SidebarMenu>
    </SidebarFooter>
  );
}

export function SidebarRightSideExample() {
  return (
    <div className={DEMO_FRAME}>
      <SidebarProvider
        defaultOpen
        enableKeyboardShortcut={false}
        className="h-full min-h-0"
      >
        <Sidebar side="right" variant="sidebar" collapsible="icon">
          <BrandHeader />
          <NavMain />
          <UserFooter />
          <SidebarRail />
        </Sidebar>
        <SidebarInset>
          <header className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 border-b border-sidebar-border px-4">
            <span className="text-sm text-sidebar-foreground">
              Dashboard
            </span>
            <SidebarTrigger className="ml-auto" />
          </header>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col" />
        </SidebarInset>
      </SidebarProvider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Controlled state

Use `open` + `onOpenChange` on `SidebarProvider` when the parent owns collapse state.

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);

<SidebarProvider open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  ...
</SidebarProvider>;
```

## Polymorphism (`render` vs shadcn `asChild`)

Vittal Design uses Base UI’s `render` prop instead of Radix `asChild`:

```tsx
// shadcn
<SidebarMenuButton asChild>
  <a href="/docs">Docs</a>
</SidebarMenuButton>

// Vittal Design
<SidebarMenuButton render={<a href="/docs" />}>
  Docs
</SidebarMenuButton>
```

Applies to: `Sidebar`, `SidebarTrigger`, `SidebarGroupLabel`, `SidebarGroupAction`, `SidebarMenuButton`, `SidebarMenuAction`, `SidebarMenuSubButton`.

### Trigger

`SidebarTrigger` shows a panel icon by default. Pass `children` to replace it, or `render` to use another element. A rendered element keeps its own look, so a VD `Button` is not restyled by the trigger:

```tsx
<SidebarTrigger
  aria-label="Quick links"
  render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon-md" />}
>
  <PanelLeftIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
</SidebarTrigger>
```

Call `event.preventDefault()` in `onClick` to stop the trigger from toggling.

### Root element

`Sidebar` renders a `<div>`. Pass `render={<aside />}` or `render={<nav aria-label="…" />}` to give the panel a landmark. On mobile the panel is a Sheet dialog and `render` is ignored.

## Keyboard

`⌘B` / `Ctrl+B` toggles the sidebar (desktop open state or mobile sheet).

## Cookie / open state

`SidebarProvider` **writes** a `sidebar_state` cookie when open state changes (for optional cross-page sync). It does **not** read the cookie on mount — initial state comes from `defaultOpen` or a controlled `open` prop. This keeps SSR and first paint predictable; read the cookie yourself only if your app needs restore-on-load.

Set `cookieName` to write under another name, or `cookieName={null}` to write no cookie. To persist state some other way, use `onOpenChange`.

## Theme CSS variables

Sidebar colors use shadcn-compatible semantic slots. Defaults are defined in `tokens/semantic/color.json` and emitted to `src-v2/styles/tokens/generated.css` (imported via `globals.css`). See [Colors → Sidebar](/docs/design-tokens/colors#sidebar).

| Variable                       | Default                        |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `--sidebar`                    | `var(--grayscale-100)`         |
| `--sidebar-foreground`         | `var(--grayscale-900)`         |
| `--sidebar-primary`            | `var(--primary-500)`           |
| `--sidebar-primary-foreground` | `#fff`                         |
| `--sidebar-accent`             | `var(--primary-50)`            |
| `--sidebar-accent-foreground`  | `var(--primary-700)`           |
| `--sidebar-border`             | `var(--grayscale-opacity-200)` |
| `--sidebar-ring`               | `var(--primary-300)`           |

Layout widths are set on the provider wrapper:

- `--sidebar-width`: `16rem`
- `--sidebar-width-icon`: `3rem`
- Mobile sheet width: `18rem`

## Mobile

Below `768px`, `Sidebar` renders as a `Sheet` controlled by `openMobile`. Place a `SidebarTrigger` outside the panel (typically in `SidebarInset` header chrome) — or call `useSidebar().toggleSidebar` — to open it. `SidebarTrigger` sets `aria-expanded` from mobile/desktop open state.

Pass `isMobile` to `SidebarProvider` to replace the built-in `768px` check, for example with your own breakpoint. `isMobile={false}` never switches to the Sheet: the trigger and `⌘B` always toggle the desktop panel. Use it when your layout handles small screens itself.

Menu actions default to **buttons**. Use the `render` prop for links (`render={<a href="…" />}`) on `SidebarMenuButton` / `SidebarMenuSubButton`.

## Embedding and multiple sidebars

When a sidebar lives inside another app's page, or two sidebars share a page (for example a shell's quick-links panel next to a product's sidebar):

- **Cookie:** give each `SidebarProvider` its own `cookieName`, or `null` when the page is not yours. A cookie written from an embedded sidebar lands on the host's domain.
- **Shortcut:** enable `⌘B` on at most one provider. Every enabled provider listens on `window`, so two would toggle together. Turn it off (`enableKeyboardShortcut={false}`) when the host page owns its shortcuts.
- **Layout:** the provider renders a `flex min-h-svh` wrapper. When your own layout positions the panel, pass `className="contents"` so the wrapper only holds state.
- **Popups:** menus inside the sidebar portal to `document.body`. If your theme tokens are scoped to a container, pass that container to the popup (for example `DropdownMenuContent`'s `portalContainer`).
- **Menu rows outside a provider:** `SidebarMenuButton` also renders without a `SidebarProvider`, as if expanded and without its tooltip, so a list component built from it can be rendered and tested on its own.

# Slider

> Select a numeric value or range from a bounded scale.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/slider

## Preview

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderLabel,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
  SliderValue,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function SliderWithLabelAndValueExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(60);

  return (
    <div className="w-[225px]">
      <Slider
        value={value}
        onValueChange={(nextValue) => {
          if (typeof nextValue === 'number') {
            setValue(nextValue);
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <SliderLabel>Volume</SliderLabel>
          <SliderValue />
        </div>
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb />
        </SliderControl>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Usage

Compose `SliderControl`, `SliderTrack`, `SliderIndicator`, and one `SliderThumb` per value inside `Slider`. Add `SliderLabel` and `SliderValue` to show what the slider controls and its current value. A single value is a `number`; `onValueChange` receives a `number` or an array depending on the value shape, so narrow it before storing it.

## Range

Use an array value and render one thumb for each value.

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function SliderRangeExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<readonly number[]>([25, 75]);

  return (
    <div className="w-[225px]">
      <Slider
        value={value}
        onValueChange={(nextValue) => {
          if (Array.isArray(nextValue)) {
            setValue(nextValue);
          }
        }}
      >
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb index={0} />
          <SliderThumb index={1} />
        </SliderControl>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Disabled

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';

export function SliderDisabledExample() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[225px]">
      <Slider defaultValue={50} disabled>
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb />
        </SliderControl>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Step

Step values render tick dots on the track.

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';

export function SliderStepExample() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[225px]">
      <Slider defaultValue={40} step={10}>
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb />
        </SliderControl>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Min And Max

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';

export function SliderMinMaxExample() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[225px]">
      <Slider defaultValue={20} min={-40} max={40} step={20}>
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb />
        </SliderControl>
        <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between font-sans text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-600">
          <span>-40</span>
          <span>40</span>
        </div>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Vertical

```tsx
import {
  Slider,
  SliderControl,
  SliderIndicator,
  SliderThumb,
  SliderTrack,
} from '@/components/ui/Slider';

export function SliderVerticalExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-48 items-center justify-center">
      <Slider defaultValue={60} orientation="vertical">
        <SliderControl>
          <SliderTrack>
            <SliderIndicator />
          </SliderTrack>
          <SliderThumb />
        </SliderControl>
      </Slider>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Props

### Slider

`Slider` is the root component.

| Prop                    | Type                                       | Default        | Description                                |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `defaultValue`          | `number \| readonly number[]`              | —              | Uncontrolled initial value                 |
| `value`                 | `number \| readonly number[]`              | —              | Controlled value                           |
| `onValueChange`         | `(value, eventDetails) => void`            | —              | Called when the value changes              |
| `onValueCommitted`      | `(value, eventDetails) => void`            | —              | Called when interaction commits            |
| `min`                   | `number`                                   | `0`            | Minimum value                              |
| `max`                   | `number`                                   | `100`          | Maximum value                              |
| `step`                  | `number`                                   | `1`            | Step increment                             |
| `largeStep`             | `number`                                   | `10`           | Page and shift-key step increment          |
| `disabled`              | `boolean`                                  | `false`        | Disables interaction                       |
| `orientation`           | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'`               | `'horizontal'` | Slider orientation                         |
| `minStepsBetweenValues` | `number`                                   | `0`            | Minimum step distance between range values |
| `name`                  | `string`                                   | —              | Form field name                            |
| `form`                  | `string`                                   | —              | Associated form id                         |
| `format`                | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions`                 | —              | Value formatting options                   |
| `locale`                | `Intl.LocalesArgument`                     | —              | Locale for value formatting                |
| `className`             | `string \| (state) => string \| undefined` | —              | Additional classes for the root element    |

### SliderThumb

| Prop               | Type                                       | Default | Description                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | ------- | -------------------------------- |
| `index`            | `number`                                   | `0`     | Thumb index for range sliders    |
| `getAriaLabel`     | `(index: number) => string`                | —       | Accessible label for the input   |
| `getAriaValueText` | `(formatted, value, index) => string`      | —       | Accessible value text            |
| `inputRef`         | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>`                    | —       | Ref for the nested range input   |
| `className`        | `string \| (state) => string \| undefined` | —       | Additional classes for the thumb |

### Slider Parts

`SliderControl`, `SliderTrack`, `SliderIndicator`, `SliderValue`, and `SliderLabel` forward refs to their underlying DOM elements and accept Base UI `className` state functions.

# SplitButton

> A split action built from ButtonGroup with a primary action and a separate toggle trigger.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/split-button

## Preview

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function SplitButtonExample() {
  const [lastAction, setLastAction] = useState('Nothing saved yet');

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
      <DropdownMenu>
        <SplitButton
          theme="primary"
          size="lg"
          onClick={() => setLastAction('Saved')}
          splitRender={<DropdownMenuTrigger />}
        >
          Save
        </SplitButton>
        <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onClick={() => setLastAction('Saved as draft')}
          >
            Save as draft
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onClick={() => setLastAction('Saved and published')}
          >
            Save and publish
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
      <p className="text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-700">
        {lastAction}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Usage

Put `SplitButton` inside a `DropdownMenu` and pass `splitRender={<DropdownMenuTrigger />}`. The chevron becomes the menu trigger: it opens the menu, positions it, supports the keyboard, and flips while the menu is open. The main button keeps its own `onClick`.

The menu is anchored to the chevron. Set `align="end"` so its right edge lines up with the right edge of the SplitButton.

## With Icon

Pass an icon as a child with `data-icon="inline-start"`. Install or import the icon separately from SplitButton.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/DropdownMenu';
import { MagnifyingGlassIcon } from '@/components/icons/MagnifyingGlassIcon';

export function SplitButtonWithIconExample() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <SplitButton
        theme="primary"
        splitRender={<DropdownMenuTrigger />}
      >
        <MagnifyingGlassIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
        Search
      </SplitButton>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
        <DropdownMenuItem>Search files</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Search issues</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

## Chevron Label

The chevron's accessible name defaults to `More options`. Set `splitLabel` to describe what the menu holds, or to translate it:

```tsx
<SplitButton splitLabel="More save options" splitRender={<DropdownMenuTrigger />}>
  Save
</SplitButton>
```

## Controlled Chevron

For a popup that is not a `DropdownMenu`, control the chevron yourself with `open` and `splitOnClick`. `open` flips the chevron and switches its name between `Expand options` and `Collapse options`.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function SplitButtonControlledChevronExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <SplitButton
      theme="default"
      size="lg"
      open={open}
      splitOnClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
    >
      Save
    </SplitButton>
  );
}
```

## Themes

`theme` takes the same values as `Button`.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';

export function SplitButtonThemesExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <SplitButton theme="primary">Primary</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="default">Default</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="success">Success</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="info">Info</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="warning">Warning</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="alarm">Alarm</SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="dangerous">Dangerous</SplitButton>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

`size="lg"` adds the themed drop shadow and hover lift; `size="md"`
is the compact variant without shadow.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';

export function SplitButtonSizesExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <SplitButton theme="primary" size="md">
        Medium
      </SplitButton>
      <SplitButton theme="primary" size="lg">
        Large
      </SplitButton>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## States

`open` shows the chevron in its open state. `disabled` disables both segments; add `focusableWhenDisabled` to keep them in the tab order.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@/components/ui/SplitButton';

const states = [
  { label: 'Default', props: {} },
  { label: 'Open', props: { open: true } },
  { label: 'Disabled', props: { disabled: true } },
];

export function SplitButtonStatesExample() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-fit grid-cols-[auto_auto_auto] items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-3 text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-700">
      {states.map(({ label, props }) => (
        <div key={label} className="contents">
          <span>{label}</span>
          <SplitButton theme="primary" {...props}>
            Save
          </SplitButton>
          <SplitButton theme="default" {...props}>
            Save
          </SplitButton>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop                    | Type                                                                                   | Default          | Description                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `open`                  | `boolean`                                                                              | —                | Puts the chevron in its open state. Leave unset with `splitRender`                                 |
| `splitRender`           | `ReactElement`                                                                         | —                | Renders the chevron as another element, usually `<DropdownMenuTrigger />`                          |
| `splitLabel`            | `string`                                                                               | `'More options'` | Accessible name of the chevron. With `open`, defaults to `'Expand options'` / `'Collapse options'` |
| `theme`                 | `'primary' \| 'default' \| 'success' \| 'info' \| 'warning' \| 'alarm' \| 'dangerous'` | `'default'`      | Color theme (matches `Button`)                                                                     |
| `size`                  | `'md' \| 'lg'`                                                                         | `'md'`           | Button size                                                                                        |
| `onClick`               | `(e: MouseEvent) => void`                                                              | —                | Handler for the main button area                                                                   |
| `splitOnClick`          | `(e: MouseEvent) => void`                                                              | —                | Handler for the arrow trigger                                                                      |
| `focusableWhenDisabled` | `boolean`                                                                              | `false`          | Keeps keyboard focus on the button when disabled styling is applied                                |
| `disabled`              | `boolean`                                                                              | `false`          | Disables the entire button                                                                         |

# Switch

> A toggle control for boolean on/off settings.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/switch

## Preview

```tsx
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/Field';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/Switch';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function SwitchExample() {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Field orientation="horizontal" className="w-auto items-center">
      <Switch
        id="switch-notifications"
        checked={checked}
        onCheckedChange={setChecked}
      />
      <FieldLabel htmlFor="switch-notifications">
        Email notifications
      </FieldLabel>
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## Usage

Give the switch a visible label: put it in a horizontal `Field` with a `FieldLabel` whose `htmlFor` matches the switch `id`. Without a visible label, pass `aria-label`.

## States

The disabled state accepts both `checked={false}` and `checked={true}`. Use `aria-invalid` for invalid styling.

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/Switch';

const states = [
  { label: 'Off', props: {} },
  { label: 'On', props: { checked: true } },
  { label: 'Disabled', props: { disabled: true } },
  { label: 'Disabled on', props: { checked: true, disabled: true } },
  { label: 'Invalid', props: { 'aria-invalid': true } },
  {
    label: 'Invalid on',
    props: { 'aria-invalid': true, checked: true },
  },
];

export function SwitchStatesExample() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-fit grid-cols-[auto_auto] items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-3 text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-700">
      {states.map(({ label, props }) => (
        <div key={label} className="contents">
          <span>{label}</span>
          <Switch aria-label={label} {...props} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop              | Type                         | Default | Description                         |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `checked`         | `boolean`                    | —       | Controls the toggle state           |
| `defaultChecked`  | `boolean`                    | `false` | Sets the uncontrolled initial state |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | —       | Called when toggled                 |
| `disabled`        | `boolean`                    | `false` | Disables interaction                |
| `aria-invalid`    | `boolean`                    | —       | Applies invalid styling             |
| `className`       | `string`                     | —       | Additional CSS classes              |
| `...props`        | `BaseSwitch.Root.Props`      | —       | Passed to the Base UI root          |

# Table

> Semantic <table> primitives with VD tokens for static tables and custom compositions.

Source: https://vittal.design/docs/components/table

## Preview

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/Avatar';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/Checkbox';
import {
  ProgressSegment,
  ProgressSegments,
} from '@/components/ui/Progress';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/Table';
import { useState } from 'react';

type TaskProgressState = 'complete' | 'review' | 'draft';

const tasks: {
  id: number;
  topic: string;
  cycle: string;
  owner: string;
  reviewer: string;
  progress: TaskProgressState;
  due: string;
  updated: string;
}[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    topic: 'Greenhouse gas emissions',
    cycle: 'Yearly',
    owner: 'JC',
    reviewer: 'JC',
    progress: 'complete',
    due: '2025/03/01',
    updated: '1 year ago',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    topic: 'Climate-related risks',
    cycle: 'Quarterly',
    owner: 'JC',
    reviewer: 'JC',
    progress: 'review',
    due: '2025/03/01',
    updated: '3 months ago',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    topic: 'Energy management',
    cycle: 'Monthly',
    owner: 'JC',
    reviewer: 'TS',
    progress: 'draft',
    due: '2025/03/01',
    updated: '1 month ago',
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    topic: 'Water management',
    cycle: 'Monthly',
    owner: 'AL',
    reviewer: 'JC',
    progress: 'draft',
    due: '2025/03/01',
    updated: '1 day ago',
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    topic: 'Waste management',
    cycle: 'Monthly',
    owner: 'TS',
    reviewer: 'JC',
    progress: 'draft',
    due: '2025/03/01',
    updated: '1 month ago',
  },
];

function Assignee({ children }: { children: string }) {
  return (
    <Avatar
      fallback={children}
      name={children}
      size="sm"
      color={children === 'TS' ? 'orange' : 'tiffany'}
    />
  );
}

function TaskProgress({ state }: { state: TaskProgressState }) {
  if (state === 'complete') {
    return (
      <ProgressSegments
        aria-label="Yearly progress"
        className="w-[118px]"
      >
        <ProgressSegment className="flex-1 bg-success-500" />
      </ProgressSegments>
    );
  }

  if (state === 'review') {
    return (
      <ProgressSegments
        aria-label="Quarterly progress"
        className="w-[118px] gap-[3px]"
      >
        <ProgressSegment className="flex-1 bg-success-500" />
        <ProgressSegment className="flex-1 bg-warning-500" />
        <ProgressSegment className="flex-1 bg-grayscale-opacity-600" />
        <ProgressSegment className="flex-1" data-state="inactive" />
      </ProgressSegments>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ProgressSegments
      aria-label="Monthly progress"
      className="w-[118px] gap-0.5"
    >
      <ProgressSegment className="w-2 bg-success-500" />
      <ProgressSegment className="w-2 bg-warning-500" />
      <ProgressSegment className="w-2 bg-info-500" />
      <ProgressSegment className="w-2 bg-destructive-500" />
      {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) => (
        <ProgressSegment
          key={index}
          className="w-2"
          data-state="inactive"
        />
      ))}
    </ProgressSegments>
  );
}

export function TableExample() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number[]>([5]);
  const allSelected = selected.length === tasks.length;

  return (
    <Table
      striped
      containerClassName="max-w-5xl rounded-(--radius-sm) border border-grayscale-opacity-300 bg-background shadow-(--shadow-base)"
    >
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>
            <Checkbox
              aria-label="Select all"
              checked={allSelected}
              indeterminate={selected.length > 0 && !allSelected}
              onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                setSelected(
                  checked ? tasks.map((task) => task.id) : [],
                )
              }
            />
          </TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[72px] text-center">ID</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Topic</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[96px]">Cycle</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[102px]">Owner</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[102px]">Reviewer</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[132px]">Progress</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[104px]">Due</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-[112px]">Last updated</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {tasks.map((task) => {
          const isSelected = selected.includes(task.id);

          return (
            <TableRow
              key={task.id}
              data-state={isSelected ? 'selected' : undefined}
            >
              <TableCell>
                <Checkbox
                  aria-label={`Select ${task.topic}`}
                  checked={isSelected}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                    setSelected((current) =>
                      checked
                        ? [...current, task.id]
                        : current.filter((id) => id !== task.id),
                    )
                  }
                />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-center">{task.id}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{task.topic}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{task.cycle}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <Assignee>{task.owner}</Assignee>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <Assignee>{task.reviewer}</Assignee>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <TaskProgress state={task.progress} />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{task.due}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{task.updated}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          );
        })}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

## Basic

```tsx
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/Table';

const invoices = [
  {
    invoice: 'INV001',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$250.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Credit Card',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV002',
    paymentStatus: 'Pending',
    totalAmount: '$150.00',
    paymentMethod: 'PayPal',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV003',
    paymentStatus: 'Unpaid',
    totalAmount: '$350.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Bank Transfer',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV004',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$450.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Credit Card',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV005',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$550.00',
    paymentMethod: 'PayPal',
  },
];

export function TableBasicExample() {
  return (
    <Table>
      <TableCaption>A list of your recent invoices.</TableCaption>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Invoice</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {invoices.map((invoice) => (
          <TableRow key={invoice.invoice}>
            <TableCell className="font-medium">
              {invoice.invoice}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>{invoice.paymentStatus}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>{invoice.paymentMethod}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              {invoice.totalAmount}
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

## When to use

- **Static or simple tables**: read-only layouts, summary tables, low row counts.
- **Custom table compositions**: use the markup primitive when you need full control over column rendering.
- **Interactive tables**: sorting, column resize, pinning, and cell editing live on the [Data Table](/docs/blocks/data-table) block.

## Parts

| Part           | Element     | Notes                                                                                                                       |
| -------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Table`        | `<table>`   | Wrapped in a scroll container. Use `containerClassName` to style the frame and `containerRef` to reach it.                  |
| `TableHeader`  | `<thead>`   | Adds a bottom border on each child `<tr>`.                                                                                  |
| `TableBody`    | `<tbody>`   | Drops the border from the last row.                                                                                         |
| `TableFooter`  | `<tfoot>`   | Muted background with top border.                                                                                           |
| `TableRow`     | `<tr>`      | Hover + `aria-expanded` + `data-state="selected"` styling.                                                                  |
| `TableHead`    | `<th>`      | Dense header cell with right border. `position: relative`, so edge overlays (e.g. a column resize handle) can anchor to it. |
| `TableCell`    | `<td>`      | Dense body cell with right border.                                                                                          |
| `TableCaption` | `<caption>` | Muted, top margin.                                                                                                          |

## Scroll container

`Table` renders its `<table>` inside a `div[data-slot="table-container"]` that
owns the horizontal scroll. `ref` points at the `<table>`, so anything that has
to observe or drive scrolling — infinite scroll, virtualisation, scroll-position
restore — needs `containerRef` instead.

```tsx
const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

<Table containerRef={containerRef}>…</Table>;
```

Because the container sets `overflow-x`, the browser computes `overflow-y` as
`auto` too. Nesting it inside another scrolling region therefore produces two
scroll areas; pass `containerClassName="overflow-x-visible"` to opt out when the
outer region should own the scroll.

## Striped rows

The `striped` prop on `Table` shades every other row in `<tbody>`. `true` is the same as `'even'` (rows 2, 4, … are shaded); use `'odd'` to shade rows 1, 3, ….

```tsx
<Table striped>…</Table>
<Table striped="odd">…</Table>
```

The colors are CSS variables you can override on `Table`:

| Variable            | Default                                                                               | Description                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--table-stripe`    | `var(--grayscale-opacity-100)`                                                        | Stripe background                                                 |
| `--table-row-hover` | `var(--grayscale-opacity-200)` when striped, otherwise `var(--grayscale-opacity-100)` | Background for hover, `aria-expanded` and `data-state="selected"` |

Hover and selected always win over the stripe color, so with `striped` on, hover goes one step darker to keep the contrast.

```tsx
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/Table';

const invoices = [
  {
    invoice: 'INV001',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$250.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Credit Card',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV002',
    paymentStatus: 'Pending',
    totalAmount: '$150.00',
    paymentMethod: 'PayPal',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV003',
    paymentStatus: 'Unpaid',
    totalAmount: '$350.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Bank Transfer',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV004',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$450.00',
    paymentMethod: 'Credit Card',
  },
  {
    invoice: 'INV005',
    paymentStatus: 'Paid',
    totalAmount: '$550.00',
    paymentMethod: 'PayPal',
  },
];

const variants = [
  { label: 'striped (even)', striped: true },
  { label: 'striped="odd"', striped: 'odd' },
] as const;

export function TableStripedExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      {variants.map(({ label, striped }) => (
        <div key={label} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-600">
            {label}
          </p>
          <Table striped={striped}>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Invoice</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {invoices.map((invoice) => (
                <TableRow key={invoice.invoice}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">
                    {invoice.invoice}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{invoice.paymentStatus}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{invoice.paymentMethod}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    {invoice.totalAmount}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      ))}

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-grayscale-opacity-600">
          Custom colors: [--table-stripe] / [--table-row-hover]
        </p>
        <Table
          striped
          className="[--table-row-hover:var(--primary-100)] [--table-stripe:var(--primary-50)]"
        >
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Invoice</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {invoices.map((invoice) => (
              <TableRow key={invoice.invoice}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">
                  {invoice.invoice}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{invoice.paymentStatus}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">
                  {invoice.totalAmount}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
